build.description: No-op build. Every workspace depends on @repo/config for its eslint, prettier, tsconfig, and tailwind presets, so this task's hash propagates to the entire graph. Inputs are narrowed to the preset files themselves; the package's own tests, CHANGELOG, and turbo logs are excluded so editing them does not invalidate every downstream build.

test.description: The contract tests read files outside this package, so those files are inputs too (issue #353): the root guides, ruleset, workflows, Dockerfiles, .gitignore, package.json, turbo.json, tooling/dev-mobile-lan.ts, every workspace's manifest, tsconfig.build.json, turbo.json, and vitest config, and every src/** TypeScript file (the @repo/* export and vitest-import scans). Globs stay narrow because explicit inputs also match gitignored files such as dist/ and .turbo/*.log.
